skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: 'Afternoon Teatime'
skins.content: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/'Afternoon Teatime'. A cozy, snug-fitting exercise wardrobe paired with a vivid jacket, ensuring the customer will be the center of attention wherever they go.
skins.quote: To Aciddrop, 'afternoon teatime' should really mean chowing down on a pizza meal set for one, grabbing a canvas to test out a spray can, then putting foot to board and heading out for a free skate, destination nada.

skins.name: Holiday HD75
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD75. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
skins.quote: 'A surfing shooting challenge? That's just a skateboard trick challenge on water. Watch, I'm gonna get full points!'
